newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Talbots FY97 EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Talbots FY97 EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Everen Securities analyst Kevin Silverman said Tuesday he reduced his earnings estimate for the first quarter of fiscal 1997 ending in April to $0.56 a share from $0.70.
-- He also cut his earnings estimate for fiscal 1997 ending in January 1998 to $2.10 a share from $2.25. The fiscal 1998 estimate was reduced to $2.45 from $2.65.
-- Silverman said the estimates were cut based on softness in first quarter sales.
-- "We do expect results to improve in the second half, as sales comparisons get easier, and the company's new promotional efforts get underway," Silverman said in a report.
